camel_example: aliyun polardb TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'pc-00000000000000000' --Tag.1.Key type --Tag.1.Value test --ResourceType cluster --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
kebab_example: aliyun polardb tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --resource-id pc-00000000000000000 --tag Value=test Key=type --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to cluster
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target cluster
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. To add multiple tags to the cluster at once, click Add to specify multiple tag keys.

You can add a maximum of 20 tag pairs at a time. `Tag.n.Key` corresponds to `Tag.n.Value`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。若您需要为目标集群一次性添加多个标签，请单击添加来添加标签键。

每次最多添加20对标签，`Tag.n.Key`对应的值为`Tag.n.Value`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. To add multiple tags to the cluster at once, click Add to specify multiple tag values.

You can add a maximum of 20 tag pairs at a time. `Tag.n.Value` corresponds to `Tag.n.Key`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。若您需要为目标集群一次性添加多个标签，请单击添加来添加标签值。

每次最多添加20对标签，`Tag.n.Value`对应的值为`Tag.n.Key`
fields.name: value
